name: Scarlet Finch
rangeDescription: Himalayas (nepal to southwestern china, myanmar, northern laos, and northern vietnam)
description: The brilliantly red male is fittingly named and unmistakable. The female and juvenile are duller, but still recognizable with overall greenish-yellow tones, a yellow rump, and a thick pinkish bill.

name: Strange Weaver
rangeDescription: Montane forest of eastern democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, rwanda, and burundi
description: Unusual weaver with a black head, dark olive-green back, and yellow belly. The male shows a chestnut patch on the breast; in females this patch extends onto the throat.

name: American Herring Gull
rangeDescription: Northern north america (alaska to atlantic coast); winters to central america
description: Common and widespread large gull found throughout North America. Adults have a fairly pale gray back, pale eye, and dull pinkish legs.

name: West African Batis
rangeDescription: Humid forest of sierra leone to southern cameroon and gabon
description: A classically patterned batis of forest, forest edges, villages, and towns in tropical lowlands and foothills. Males have white underparts bisected by a black chest band, mostly black upperparts with a broken white eye-line, white on the nape, scalloped white and gray on the back, and a white wingbar that extends to the tip of the wings in the secondary flight feathers.

name: Heinroth's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Presumably breeds montane bougainville, kolombangara, and rendova (northern and west-central solomon islands); non-breeders range to flores, molucca seas, and bismarck archipelago
description: A small, distinctively proportioned shearwater with a comparatively long-necked, long-tailed, round-winged appearance. Entirely dark plumage contrasts with variably white bars on the underside of remarkably short, stubby wings.

name: Campina Thrush
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia eastward to southern venezuela and guyana, southward locally to central amazonian brazil, from the east bank of the río madeira to the east bank of the río tapajós
description: A drab thrush, uncommon in open habitats and woodlands in the lowlands. Nondescript grayish-brown with a pale whitish belly.

name: Small Pratincole
rangeDescription: Eastern afghanistan and pakistan to india and indochina
description: Small bird that resembles a combination of a dove, a swallow, and a plover. Soft gray-brown with a tan wash on the throat and black lores.

name: White-cheeked Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Montane forest of vietnam and southern laos
description: A garrulous, sociable bird, often found in large flocks, both single-species and mixed. Warm brown with a gray crown, a broad black mask, and a luminously white cheek spot, and long white-tipped tail.

name: Sulawesi Pygmy Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Sulawesi, togian islands (to northeast) and buton (to southeast)
description: A small brown-and-white woodpecker with scattered pale bars and spots on the upperparts and dark-streaked white underparts. Male possess a red nape patch that is absent in females.

name: Mariana Swiftlet
rangeDescription: Northern mariana islands (saipan, tinian, and aguijan) and guam
description: A tiny, all-dark swift. Flight is fast, fluttery, and batlike.

name: Sri Lanka Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Dwarf bamboo montane forest of sri lanka
description: Small, nondescript, earthy-brown colored bird, with a graduated tail. Note particularly rich, buffy throat, short, indistinct grey eyebrow, and pale iris.

name: Rusty Tinamou
rangeDescription: Disjunctly in humid forest of northwestern brazil and probably adjacent far eastern colombia; and the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil (amapá)
description: Small tinamou, barred cinnamon and black above, rusty below, with a pale belly. Found mostly in seasonally flooded forest, but also recorded in upland forest, where it forages on the ground.

name: Black-crowned Barwing
rangeDescription: Western highlands of vietnam
description: The black crown and wingtips of this gray-headed barwing set it apart from other species within its range. Bright white eyering gives it a “goggled” appearance.

name: Ancash Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Western andes of peru (southern cajamarca to ancash)
description: Small tapaculo found only at very high elevations in the western Andes of northern Peru. Plumage is gray with brown rear parts and dark barring on belly and tail.

name: Tocuyo Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of northeastern colombia and northwestern venezuela
description: A large sparrow with bold black stripes on a gray head, olive-brown upperparts, and whitish underparts with buffy gray tinge. Eyebrow whitish, usually paler face and median crown stripe.

name: Yellow-crowned Manakin
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southwestern venezuela and northern amazonian brazil
description: Fairly large, distinctive manakin. Males have olive backs and are rusty colored below, contrasting with a white throat.

name: Tawny-bellied Seedeater
rangeDescription: Bolivia to paraguay, southern brazil and northern argentina
description: Small finchlike species with a short and stubby bill. Males are gray above and tawny below with a tawny rump.

name: Costa Rican Pygmy-Owl
rangeDescription: Mountains of central costa rica to western panama
description: Small owl, active during the day and night. Very similar in plumage to other pygmy-owls, but limited range at high elevation (mostly above 1000m) is a good starting point.

name: Bulwer's Pheasant
rangeDescription: Submontane forest of interior borneo
description: Uncommon, medium-sized pheasant. Male is almost unbelievable-looking; an immense fan of a snow-white tail sticks out of a rotund, coal-black body.

name: Christmas Island Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Inland plateau of christmas island (eastern indian ocean)
description: Large slate-gray pigeon with glossy green iridescence (can be difficult to make out in poor light) on the back and wings. Also note staring yellow eyes, chestnut undertail coverts, and faint pale patch just above the bill.
